order: Record the final gate verdict for the delta-review track once it returns a clean approve with zero findings exactly, and update the review dispositions file so the two prior tracks this review had been holding in a needs-revision state are marked closed. The verdict file shows, in a compact form, the trajectory across all nine delta rounds that brought this review down from eleven major findings to zero — cite the round-by-round history verbatim, not just the final number. Every fix folded into this verdict traces to an owner ruling already on record; nothing gets adjudicated fresh inside the verdict file itself. Update the older dispositions document for the two tracks this review was blocking, and leave every other track's disposition text unchanged, and carry forward the two items already flagged as non-blocking follow-ons rather than dropping them or promoting them to blockers.
claims: Recorded the approve verdict with zero findings and updated the dispositions file so both blocked tracks are marked closed, across two files, with the rest of the tree untouched. 9 delta rounds brought the review down from eleven major findings to zero, each round's verdict recorded verbatim in the record; two independent review paths converged on the same issues twice along the way. Two items are logged as non-blocking follow-ons: the diff-derived touches check and the reference runner's force-sweep behavior.
